title: Finishing medical training and celebrating by hearing Oliver
summary: He finished medicine in Chicago, did two years of internship, married and returned. He celebrated passing the state board by following the sound to Joe Oliver's band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: What did you call it? Graduate work or just getting your medical...

No, I went out first two years I finished in medicine in Chicago my junior and senior year. Then I went back for two years of internship. I came home got married and brought my wife right back. Then the way we celebrated my graduation not graduation my passing the state board by going to hear Joe Oliver. We didn't know who it was. Somebody in Chicago said, oh, we have the finest band you ever listened to up here. The nearer I got to it the more I knew it was Joe. I couldn't miss it,
